question: Q-4/Q-10: does analyst revision FLOW rank the cross-section, and does the simple net_raises x n_firms rule beat SPY net of cost?

universe.definition: xs_ranker survivorship-free bars INTERSECT tickers in the revision parquet (covered universe); SPY for beta and the market leg
universe.why_not_the_full_panel: only 64 of 1,784 delisted names have revision history; on the full panel NaN flow would encode future delisting

survivorship_audit.verdict: SURVIVOR-SELECTED: no symbol stops trading, which cannot happen in a real US cross-section. Every result over this panel is biased toward whatever the dead names were — small, illiquid and distressed.

sampling.blocking: t across blocks of ceil(H/step) consecutive decision dates
